# Feature report draft (made up)

Acme Notes is a shared note app for small teams [product-acme-notes, E-001]. Its features are split
between an Editor and an Admin module [module-editor, module-admin].

## Features

Export was seen working in the hands-on session: three clicks, and the file downloaded straight
away [feature-export, E-006]. The formats offered are CSV and Markdown [E-005].

- Single sign-on is only on the Business plan [feature-sso, E-010].
- Version history is also a Business feature [feature-version-history, E-008].

## Plans

| Plan | Unlocks | Cited |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Free | Export | [pricing_tier-free, E-003] |
| Business | Export, version history, single sign-on | [pricing_tier-business, E-004] |
